weights: W1 unchanged signed6 values, lossless neuron-major Huffman stream; W2 signed8 and signed32 accumulators unchanged
low_output_head: 128 signed8 weights plus4 signed32 biases; shared W1 and multiplier
input_modes: Native48 for ROI>=192px, native32 for128..191px; preview native32 or48 decimated to32
histogram_normalization: Native48 raw half-counts floor; native32 unchanged, packed9-bit counts plus distributed remainder
capture_prefilter: mean of x-1/x by y-1/y, half-up (sum+2)>>2 at each native48 sample (ROI>=192px) or native32 sample (ROI128..191px); sampled positions must be on-screen
training: scripts/train_expression_v15.py + calibrate_expression_v15.py + train_low_head_v15.py; H32 signed6 QAT warm-start V14, FER+ sadness/anger/fear proxy for visible tense appearance (not NERVOUS/AU ground truth), soft vote distributions mixed60/40 with majority labels, explicit train-only tense-HAPPY and tense-neutral competition, official GENKI smile-only marginal loss and eyewear/glare/area/light/affine augmentation; FER Training/PublicTest and GENKI train/validation only
data: FER2013 pixels / Microsoft FER+ majority labels >=6; exact duplicates removed by unchanged V6 split; GENKI official smile/non-smile labels; raw datasets not distributed
nervous_proxy: FER+ sadness,anger,fear grouped into target2; no direct nervous/action-unit labels. OTHER keeps surprise,disgust,contempt,unknown,NF.
limitations: Visible appearance only, not internal state. NERVOUS is a sadness/anger/fear proxy, not genuine nervousness or AU labeling. Subtle smiles/glare remain limited. No camera validation, CNN or landmark alignment in V15.
